Build an AI App called Genova Health
Genova Health is an intelligent health companion that helps users understand their body through AI. It takes input like blood group, genotype, age, and weight, and uses that data to generate personalized diet plans, lifestyle tips, and health insights.

The app should also include a SmartScan feature, where users can place their finger on their camera or flashlight to estimate heart rate, blood pressure trends, and stress levels using PPG (photoplethysmography) analysis.

🧠 Key Features:

Sign Up / Login System – with email, Google, or biometric login (Firebase Auth).

Profile Setup: Collect blood group, genotype, age, weight, and health goals.

SmartScan Module:

Use phone camera + flashlight for biometric reading.

Display pulse, estimated BP, and heart rate results.

AI Health Coach:

Generates food recommendations, do’s and don’ts based on user profile.

Gives daily health tips and adaptive diet updates.

Dashboard:

Displays health data (heart rate, nutrition insights, stress level).

Graph view of progress.

AI Chat Assistant:

Responds to questions like “What should I eat today?” or “Why is my heart rate high?”

Trained on medical/nutrition models (use OpenAI or Gemini API).

Voice Mode (optional): For elderly users — converts text to speech and voice input.

Settings & Privacy: Allow data export/delete; show consent notice before scans.


1. Onboarding & User Medical Profile

During signup, users enter:

Full Name

Age

Blood Group

Genotype

Height

Weight

Allergies

Emergency Contact (recommended)

This profile powers personalization across all prompts.

2. Core AI Assistant Modules
A. Virtual Nurse Prompt

Acts as the user’s AI nurse.

Handles quick questions like: “My chest feels tight, what should I do?”

Provides triage-level guidance (not diagnosis).

Suggests routes: symptom checker, doctor consultation, or emergency.

B. Symptom Checker Router Prompt

Takes user-reported symptoms.

Provides possible causes (not diagnoses).

Routes users to:

Virtual nurse

Doctor appointment booking

Emergency button

Nutrition or mental health modules if relevant

C. Nutrition Assistant Prompt

Diet plans based on genotype (e.g., AS/SS), blood group, allergies, weight goals.

Nigerian foods included (e.g., amala, suya, efo riro).

Meal reminders + hydration tracking.

D. Workout Assistant Prompt

AI workout plans tailored by:

Age

Weight

Height

Goals (weight loss, muscle gain, cardio health)

Home workouts & gym variants.

Syncs with step tracker.

E. Mental Wellness Assistant Prompt

Mood check-in

Stress-relief exercises

Breathing guides

Daily mental health tips

Crisis routing to hotline/emergency if needed

F. Emergency Button Logic Prompt

When pressed, shows:

Nearby hospitals

Quick dial to emergency numbers

Option to notify emergency contact

AI quick triage (“Tell me your symptoms now”)

Localized for Nigeria.

G. Prescription Explanation Prompt

User can take a picture or type a medication.

AI explains:

What it’s for

Side effects

Dosage guidance

Drug-to-drug interaction warnings

Works with Nigeria’s popular drugs too.

H. Family & Child Health Prompt

For parents/caregivers:

Baby immunization reminders

Growth tracking

Child diet planning

Symptom checker adapted for children

Family medical profiles

I. Nigerian Localization Prompt

Understands Nigerian slang, foods, hospitals, common drugs.

Handles country-specific issues like:

Malaria

Typhoid

UTIs

Heat-related illnesses

Popular over-the-counter meds

3. Doctor App (For Verified Doctors)
Doctor-side MVP features

Doctor KYC verification

Consultation dashboard

Video/voice call interface

Prescription issuing

Medical note-taking

Patient history log

Patient-side doctor module

Book appointment (virtual or physical)

Pay for consultation

Get digital prescription

Chat with doctor (limited time)

See history of past visits

4. Transport/Delivery Module

Basic MVP:

Book medical test pickup

Medicine delivery

Hospital/clinic transport

Driver verification

Real-time tracking

(Not full Uber-level — basic logistics MVP.)

5. Doctor–Patient Meetup Coordinator

If a user needs a physical inspection:

AI or doctor recommends in-person exam

App shows nearby clinics

User books a physical visit

Optional: dispatch ride or at-home nurse (Phase 2)

6. Step Tracker

Tracks daily steps

Works with phone accelerometer (no smartwatch needed)

Helps calculate calories burned

Syncs with workout assistant for daily goals

GENOVA HEALTH MVP USER FLOW
User signs up → enters medical profile → lands on dashboard with:

“Ask Nurse Genova” button

Symptom Checker

Mental Health Check-In

Nutrition Plan

Workout Plan

Step Tracker

Emergency button

Book a Doctor

Delivery & Transport

Everything is AI-personalized based on their profile.

**Initiating Genova Health**

I'm currently fleshing out the core features for "Genova Health." Onboarding is my priority, specifically focusing on the user medical profile: name, age, blood type, genotype, height, weight, allergies, and emergency contact details. Following that, I'm working on the SmartScan feature, which leverages PPG analysis to derive heart rate, blood pressure trends, and stress levels using the camera and flashlight.

I've been mapping out the AI modules, envisioning a virtual nurse, a symptom checker, and assistants for nutrition, workouts, and mental wellness.
